title: Once a month we paddle out for trash
why: Behind-the-scenes on the monthly community cleanup for locals who care about the bayou; proof the brand lives the belief.
hook_options: First Sunday of the month, we fish out trash
The bayou cleanup a UH club never misses
Grab a paddle. Grab a bag.
caption: First Sunday of the month, paddlers head out on Buffalo Bayou to pull trash. Kayak, paddle, life vest and gloves provided. First-timers welcome, even if you're running late. Follow for the next date. #buffalobayou #bayoucleanup #buffalobayoukayak #houstonvolunteer

slides.headline: Once a month we paddle out for trash
slides.body: Kayak, paddle, life vest and gloves provided. Here's what the Buffalo Bayou Kayak cleanup actually looks like.

slides.headline: First Sunday of the month
slides.body: One guest put it simply: "get out there on a kayak or SUP first Sunday of the month and help clean up the bayou."

slides.headline: Out on the water, kayak by kayak
slides.body: Paddlers work the banks and haul out what the city leaves behind.

slides.headline: A hat, sunscreen, water, and a friend
slides.body: Straight from our cleanup flyer. Add a change of clothes. We cover the kayak, paddle, life vest and gloves.

slides.headline: A UH club made it a monthly habit
slides.body: Jun H., University of Houston student group: it's "the most beloved and attended event of our club every month!!"

slides.headline: Late and nervous? Still fine.
slides.body: T.J. R. was "initially very anxious" and running late. He was "warmly greeted and reassured" and got set up anyway.

slides.headline: Paddlers notice what drivers don't
slides.body: From a car the bayou is a blur. From a kayak you see every bottle snagged on a root. So we pull them.

slides.headline: It's a working urban waterway
slides.body: Some guests say the water looks rough. Fair. Monthly cleanups are how we push back, one bag at a time.

slides.headline: Then the banks look like this
slides.body: Wildflowers at water level, downtown overhead. Worth looking after.

slides.kicker: Tag a friend for first Sunday
slides.headline: Grab a paddle. Grab a bag.
slides.body: Follow for cleanup dates, or book a paddle from Allen's Landing at buffalobayoukayak.com.
